articles.title: Meloni: l'Europa difenda i propri confini con umanità ma anche intransigenza
articles.summary: Meloni supports EU sanctions against human trafficking networks and says Europe is adopting the government's tougher immigration approach.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Con Trump non mi pento di nulla, punto all'unità dell'Occidente'
articles.summary: At NATO summit in Ankara, Meloni reaffirms commitment to defense spending while rejecting Trump's criticism about refusing US military bases for Iran operations.

articles.title: Meloni: 'Un presidente della Repubblica di destra potrebbe non essere più un tabù'
articles.summary: Meloni suggests that a right-wing president of the republic could become possible and challenges the idea that non-left figures are inferior political actors.

articles.title: 'Diffamata da Corona', Giorgia Meloni pronta a testimoniare in aula a Milano
articles.summary: Meloni agrees to testify as witness in Milan court on September 28 in defamation case against Fabrizio Corona over false allegations published in October 2023.
